prompts.name: cut
prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE new FULL-BODY right-facing male Chinese ink game-character ACTION DESIGN KEYFRAME using the supplied EXACT SAME character and sword. Preserve his featureless blank side face with NO eyes nose mouth eyebrows, half-up black long hair, dark muted celadon-green Bilan Yunye robe with restrained ivory cloud and leaf patterns, ivory inner robes/trousers, black sash and boots, same five-head proportion, same simplified bold ink linework and angular shadow planes. TRUE transparent RGBA background, no paper, floor, shadow, aura, streaks, text, checkerboard or panel. One figure and ONE complete straight jian sword only. Keep consistent sword length relative to character: grip to tip about55% of standing body height. Full square spacious canvas with figure and entire sword uncropped and ample action margins. All poses face screen RIGHT. This is a completed character WITH SWORD to judge anatomy before layer extraction. Crucial: sword hilt physically passes THROUGH the natural curled grip: palm and far fingers BEHIND cylindrical hilt, near folded fingers and thumb IN FRONT of hilt, thumb points toward guard, little finger toward pommel. Five correct fingers per hand, neutral wrist, no punching fist pasted on sword, no blade emerging from heel of hand, no bent hilt. Blade must emerge from guard at index/thumb side; guard, hilt and blade share one straight axis. Match reference appearance and illustration quality, avoid extra ornate detail or glossy CG metal. ACTION: ZHAN JIAN ordinary one-handed DIAGONAL CUT finishing keyframe. A moderately forward-rooted stance, right knee flexed, torso slightly turned forward, front sword arm extends diagonally forward-right with elbow softly bent, sword blade continues FORWARD RIGHT at about15degrees DOWN from horizontal after a descending diagonal cut, hilt lower than chest but above front knee. The blade does not continue the forearm as a punching extension: use a believable rolled sword grip, knuckles and guard readable. Left free hand compact beside sash, modest hair and sleeve follow-through toward LEFT. Avoid an extreme low crouch, full arm lock or foot slide. A short decisive ordinary cut.
